title: Does A Government Mandate Crowd Out Voluntary Corporate Social Responsibility? Evidence from India
sources_checked: CMIE Prowess: exact author-package raw/prowess_csr_data_3.txt (SHA-256 d204f70a7af5012fc19a9b05eaaf2d25473626f6e26141de344cd01d990db7b7); bounded date-field check parsed 344,845 rows, FY-ending labels 2005–2019; source package does not state vendor vintage.

MCA CSR: exact author-package raw/mca_csr_data/allcomp_csr_2014_2019.csv (SHA-256 68843f1df0b4a7affa3e7ec86bcef576bb1f39fba4ded48c0555a09c80b0962e); bounded Year-field check parsed 60,485 rows, FY-ending labels 2015–2019; source package does not state vendor vintage.

Accepted prepared analysis panel: output/executions/packages/jar-73584d6b2577/work/dta/mca_starting_point_reg.dta (SHA-256 9b5467ddce5a71550bcb03ed6c936b8c62e211753976d3176d2e3bec6ef8440b); year is int16, format %8.0g, 236,044 firm-year rows, labels 2010–2019.

Local resource catalog: output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json, generated 2026-10-27; 959 registered SAS dataset entries and no matching Prowess/MCA/India entry. Catalog warns it is snapshot metadata, not verified access or coverage.

Existing construction and accepted code: author-package do/data_creation.do (SHA-256 a7f1d4cb848d6bad439782bc060aa154880d68d87dee72eab382071d3e39f11f) and do/Tables.do; the current assigned prepared branch uses Tables.do, and the named builder inputs above do not extend past 2019.
changes: The paper clock is fiscal-year ending labels: FY 2009–10 to FY 2018–19 maps to 2010–2019. Requested pooled endpoint is 2024 (FY 2023–24), retaining the same year-label convention. No code or path edits were made because post-2019 source coverage is blocked.
limitations: No current-vintage Prowess or MCA data supporting FY ending-year 2020–2024 was identified among the exact named local inputs. The author-package Prowess and MCA files end in 2019, as does the accepted prepared panel. The designated catalog snapshot has no Prowess/MCA entry and cannot prove whether an unregistered update exists elsewhere; the provider vintage of the packaged source files is undocumented.

The sample record labels the threshold as 2% and the main Table 4 sample as high-CSR firms. The builder constructs preperiod CSRRatiop_m using meanprofits, while Table 4 Panel B CSRRatio_m_w1 is constructed as CSRF_m divided by lagmeanassets. The model record separately retains unresolved PAT/PBT wording in the paper’s CSR-ratio definition. These inherited definitions were preserved; no variable or estimator changes were attempted.

The accepted author stage previously executed the full Tables.do entrypoint, but this extended-sample job did not launch it because no compatible pooled 2020–2024 source route was verified. The four assigned Table 4 fits therefore have no native log, fresh extended result, or observed added-period count.
